title: Product launch check-in
timingNote: start and end come from PCM sample counts. The MP3 encoder adds a short delay (about 0.05 s) at the start, so decoded times can be slightly later.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Hi, I'm Emma, I run marketing. Thanks for making time for the launch check-in.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Sure. I'm Daniel, the product lead. Where do you want to start?

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Quick status first. Is the build still on track?

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Yes. QA signed off yesterday and the build is stable, so we're in good shape.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Great. Then let's talk about the release notes. We need them before the press preview.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Okay, I can take that. I'll draft the release notes and have them ready by Wednesday.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Wednesday works. Thank you.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Next, the trade show next month. Do we have banners for the booth yet?

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Not yet. I'll order the banners this week. I know a printer who's quick.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Perfect, one less thing to worry about.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: We could also run a launch webinar for existing customers, and walk them through the new features.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Hmm, maybe. Let's think about it. I'm not sure we have the people for it right now.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Then the pricing page. The new prices go live on Friday, so the page has to be updated before Friday.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Agreed, that has to happen before Friday. I honestly don't know who should own it, though.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Me neither. Let's not decide that today, but it definitely has to get done.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: I'll also write the launch email to customers. I can send you a draft by Thursday.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Sounds good, Thursday works for me.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: One open point. Has legal approved the new terms of service?

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: I honestly don't know. I haven't heard anything from them.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Hmm. Okay.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Oh, one more thing about the release notes. The press preview moved earlier, so Wednesday is too late. Could you do Tuesday instead?

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Tuesday is tight, but yes. I'll get the release notes to you by Tuesday.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Thanks, that really helps.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Anything else on the trade show?

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Actually, yes. I heard this morning that we're not taking a booth at the trade show after all. The budget went to the launch.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Oh. So we don't need the banners anymore.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Right, forget the banners. I hadn't ordered them yet, so there's nothing to cancel.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Good. I think that's everything for today.

lines.speaker: EMMA
lines.text: Yes. Thanks, Daniel. Talk soon.
